recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser game called **Prism Royale: Wall Era**. Preserve the mechanics of a stationary center turret survival shooter: the player holds/drags one thumb to aim and auto-fire, enemies spawn outside the screen and converge, six wall panels block attacks, bullets kill enemies, kills increase score and a resource meter, every 100 resource grants one of several draggable tactic cards, and HP depletion opens a restartable game-over screen.

Transform the presentation into a satirical Battle Royale world with Pink-Floyd-adjacent prism/wall iconography, chrome anime cyberpunk aesthetics, and meme tone. The player is a triangular Prism Ace core. Enemies are rival echo arrows. Barricades are prism wall panels. Score is Rivals Clipped, resource is Squad Hype, waves are Eras, and failure is Wall Deleted. Use procedural canvas graphics, mobile-readable HUD, Orbitron/Rajdhani fonts, compact feedback GIFs, and scifi audio cues.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first stationary last-stand shooter / survival defense.
- objective: keep the center turret alive while clearing converging enemies, protecting a six-panel perimeter, and using earned upgrade cards.
- input model: one-thumb/pointer hold on the canvas to aim and auto-fire; pointer-drag cards from the bottom dock onto center or perimeter target zones.
- core loop: enemies spawn offscreen, move toward center, damage barricade panels or the core, bullets hit enemies, kills increase score and resource, resource spawns tactic cards, waves/eras increase every 50 kills.
- fail/friction state: barricades can break; if enemies reach and deplete core HP to zero, game over appears with final score and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Stationary centered player/turret; no locomotion was added.
- Hold/drag aim controls and continuous auto-fire cadence are preserved.
- Offscreen enemy spawn cadence, inward movement, collision radii, bullet life/speed/damage, and HP/attack timing remain equivalent.
- Six-segment perimeter defense, repair/reinforce/rapid-fire/stun upgrade effects, 100-resource card generation, 3-card cap bonus, 50-kill wave escalation, fail/restart semantics are preserved.

## Remixed target
Prism Royale: Wall Era reframes the protected last-stand survival shooter as a satirical chrome/anime cyberpunk battle royale inspired by prism/wall iconography: the player is a Prism Ace holding a battle-dome wall while meme rivals rush the ring. HUD terms, focal silhouette, hazards, upgrades, background, particles, fonts, and audio are transformed while mechanics stay source-faithful.
